aboutUs.paragraph1: With a professional real estate agent by your side, you can be sure that the entire process – from the first idea to a successful sale – runs efficiently, safely and in your best interest.
aboutUs.paragraph2: Since 1985 we have specialized in selling existing and new-build properties in the <0>Münsterland region</0>, using exclusive marketing strategies and a regional network built up over decades to achieve the best result for every property.
aboutUs.paragraph3: Our experienced team supports you personally, takes care of the details, and keeps improving so you always get the best possible service.
aboutUs.bottomLine1: Your agent team for residential properties,

fiveSteps.titleLine1: More than just real estate – a partnership
fiveSteps.subtitle: Selling your property in 5 steps

steps.title: Free property valuation & initial consultation
steps.body: The key facts about your property – location, size, year built and living space – give an initial price estimate. We determine the actual market value during an on-site appointment, where we take all relevant details into account. In a personal conversation you'll receive our valuation, the marketing strategy and tips on increasing the value.

steps.title: Signing the agency agreement
steps.body: Take your time to review our valuation and recommendations. We're available any time for questions or requests. Once you're convinced, a written agency agreement seals our cooperation. From that point on, we support you comprehensively, including valuable contacts – for example to local tradespeople for renovations or financing.

steps.title: Photo shoot, listing creation & publication
steps.body: We obtain all relevant information from authorities and administrations to inform prospective buyers as well as possible. With complete documents, professional photos and a compelling listing, we present your property optimally. Marketing follows the jointly agreed strategy – targeted at the right media and channels.

steps.title: Inquiries and viewings
steps.body: Rest assured: only serious buyers with genuine intent will view your property. We ensure this through detailed preliminary talks with all potential buyers. There's no "viewing tourism" with us. If you still live in the property, we'll of course coordinate viewing appointments flexibly with you.

steps.title: Notary appointment and certification
steps.body: Professional negotiation & a smooth closing. As your real estate partner, we handle price negotiations in your interest. Thanks to a clearly defined strategy and close coordination with you, you don't need to get involved in the negotiations yourself. As agents, we act as mediators aiming for a fair agreement both sides are happy with. Once agreed, we forward all details to the notary, who drafts the purchase contract and sends it to both parties for review. Once both sides agree, the notary appointment for signing is scheduled. After payment is received in your account, we take care of the property handover as well as notifications to the insurer and the relevant municipality. And then it's official: #SUCCESSFULLY SOLD!

heroValuation.eyebrow: Property valuation with Immo Tonn – We know the value of your home
heroValuation.title: Property valuation with heart and expertise

valuationCTA.firstTitle: Many owners ask themselves: what is my property worth today?
valuationCTA.paragraph1: Whether out of curiosity, for a possible decision to sell, or for better financial planning – a well-founded valuation provides certainty and clarity.
valuationCTA.paragraph2: As experienced partners in the insurance and real estate industry, at Immo Tonn we know what matters: market knowledge and personal advice.
valuationCTA.thirdTitle: Why is a professional valuation so important?
valuationCTA.thirdParagraph: The property market is constantly moving. Factors such as inflation, interest rates and location development affect a property's value. Anyone who wants to sell needs a reliable assessment – ideally from experts who understand both the real estate and insurance markets.
valuationCTA.cta: How much is my house worth?

competence.title: Trust through expertise
competence.paragraph1: Our clients don't just own property – they're often insured with us too. That means we know their situation, their property and their needs.
competence.paragraph2: That's exactly our advantage: we combine knowledge from two worlds – property valuation and insurance advice – for holistic support.
competence.secondTitle: Get in touch now, no obligation – your Immo Tonn team is here for you!

howIsGoing.considerTitle: What we consider in the valuation:
considerItems: Location and micro-location of the property
Potential for modernization or energy-efficient renovation
processItems: Non-binding initial consultation – by phone or on site
Analysis of property documents and viewing
Market-based valuation with a transparent result
On request: advice on selling, financing or renovation

lawAndAdvice.block1Text: We support you from the very beginning. For sellers, we help compile all necessary documents – such as the land registry extract, energy certificate and renovation records. For buyers, we transparently provide all available property documents and explain the details clearly – from the legal situation to technical features and hidden costs.
lawAndAdvice.block2Title: Style and structure for a successful viewing
lawAndAdvice.block2Text: We know how to present a property optimally. For sellers, we give valuable tips on preparing the property for viewings: lighting, tidiness, neutral furnishing and a pleasant atmosphere all play a role. We also offer professional property styling. For buyers, we help evaluate the key factors that can affect price and living quality.
lawAndAdvice.block3Title: Security and structure at every step.
lawAndAdvice.block3Text: Legal clarity is the foundation of trust. We check proof of ownership, possible encumbrances, building permits and the accuracy of all documents. For sellers, we help eliminate potential legal obstacles in advance. For buyers, we explain the documents clearly and advise on all important contract points. On request, we recommend notaries from our partner network for a secure process.
lawAndAdvice.block4Text: A realistic price and good negotiation are crucial. For sellers, we help determine market value based on location, condition and comparable properties. For buyers, we explain the price structure and assess where fair negotiation margins exist. We moderate discussions respectfully and with a solution-oriented approach.
lawAndAdvice.block5Text: Property transactions need time and clarity. We create a protected environment in which buyers and sellers can make well-informed decisions calmly. We ensure security and transparency at every level.
lawAndAdvice.goalLine1: Our goal is to make buying and selling property clear, understandable and secure.
lawAndAdvice.goalLine2: We are committed to ensuring both parties' interests are considered - so the outcome works for everyone.
